title: You Think Winning More Makes You Happier, Yet Bronze Winners Smile Wider Than Silver
description:
You think finishing higher always makes you happier! Yet third-place bronze winners beam wider than silver! This is the true story of Leon Festinger's comparison rule. Here is what went wrong with old happiness models.
